textRuns.value: Read the ranking as a league table, not a story. 660 of 663 customers have sales and the largest is 0.22% of turnover; the top 10 together are 2.1%, and first and tenth place differ by 8%. A month more data would probably reshuffle the order. Buying group is perfectly determined by sales channel — all 402 customers with a buying group are Online Sale, all 261 without are Retail Sale.
